def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv"

    # True header is on row index 2 (0-based) after title and blank row.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=2)
    df = df.rename(columns=lambda c: str(c).strip())

    # Keep only rows with a 4-digit year.
    df = df[df["Year"].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r"\d{4}")].copy()

    # Clean numeric columns (remove thousands separators) and coerce to numeric.
    for col in ["Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col].astype(str).str.replace(",", "", regex=False), errors="coerce")

    df["Year"] = df["Year"].astype(int)
    return df[["Year", "Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]]

operators.customDisplayName: Load 2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv with header=2 (skip title row and blank row so columns are [Year, Fraud, Identity Theft, Other]); strip column names; keep rows where Year is a 4-digit year; parse Fraud/Identity Theft/Other as numeric by removing thousands separators; return columns [Year, Fraud, Identity Theft, Other].

def process(reportsByType) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()
    df["total"] = df[["Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]].sum(axis=1)
    df["fraudShare"] = df["Fraud"] / df["total"]

    out = df.loc[df["fraudShare"] >= 0.5, ["Year", "fraudShare", "Fraud", "total"]].copy()
    out = out.sort_values("Year").reset_index(drop=True)
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Compute total reports per year as Fraud+Identity Theft+Other; compute fraudShare=Fraud/total; filter years where fraudShare >= 0.5; return [Year, fraudShare, Fraud, total] sorted by Year for verification.
